build_check.description: index.html and game_logic.js exist, a canvas/WebGL renderer is present, and no disallowed heavy runtime asset references are used.

requirements.description: The player character can run, jump, and wall-slide on vertical surfaces. When the player falls or quits a run, the entire run is recorded as a ghost replay. Score 0 if no ghost recording system exists.

Ghost replays from previous attempts are physically solid — the current player can stand on, jump off, and ride ghost bodies as moving platforms. Multiple ghosts replay simultaneously. Score 0 if ghosts are visual only with no collision.

The tower has sparse fixed platforms with large vertical gaps that are initially impassable. Ghosts from previous runs create the scaffolding needed to reach higher. Progress requires multiple layered attempts. Score 0 if the tower is fully climbable without ghosts.

A height meter tracks current altitude and best-ever altitude. The best height persists between sessions. Each attempt shows progress relative to the previous best. Score 0 if no height tracking exists.

A solidify mechanic allows the player to convert one ghost into a permanent fixed platform every few attempts. Solidified ghosts stop replaying and become static ledges. This choice is strategic and irreversible. Score 0 if no solidify mechanic exists.

The tower is tall enough that reaching the top requires at least 5-10 ghost layers. The vertical space is substantial with varied fixed platform placement creating different climbing challenges at different heights. Score 0 if the tower is trivially short.

The tower environment changes visually at different height tiers (at least 3 tiers) — different backgrounds, platform styles, or atmospheric effects as the player climbs higher. Score 0 if the tower looks identical at all heights.

Milestone heights unlock cosmetic rewards (trail effects, character skins, or visual flair) that are visible during gameplay. At least 3 milestones with distinct rewards exist. Score 0 if no milestone rewards exist.

Ghost data persists between game sessions — closing and reopening the game preserves all recorded ghosts and solidified platforms. The tower state accumulates over time. Score 0 if ghost data is lost on restart.

A stats screen shows total attempts, total ghosts, solidified platforms, best height, and time played. An attempt-end screen shows height reached and ghosts active. Score 0 if no stats tracking exists.
A styled title screen shows the tower with ghost silhouettes and the game name. A start button and stats access are available. Score 0 if the game starts directly in gameplay or uses raw default UI.
The game flow connects title -> climb attempt -> fall/end -> solidify choice (when available) -> next attempt without restarting. Score 0 if transitions are missing.

During gameplay, the height meter, ghost count, and best-height marker are visible. Ghosts are visually distinct from the player (semi-transparent or different color). Score 0 if no HUD or ghost distinction exists.
Readability at 1280x720 is strong: the player, ghosts, fixed platforms, solidified platforms, and tower background are all clearly distinguishable. Score 0 if elements blend together.

The art direction is coherent across title, tower, player, ghosts, and UI — a consistent ethereal tower-climbing aesthetic with unified palette. Score 0 if mostly default UI or mismatched placeholders dominate. Full credit may be earned with runtime-authored procedural textures, layered materials, deliberate multi-light rigs, particles, synthesized audio, or post-processing; external asset files are not required.

The tower environment uses real sprite or tile art for platforms, walls, backgrounds, and height-tier transitions — not plain ColorRect fills. The player and ghosts have distinct sprite art. Score 0 if environments are uniform color fills.

HUD and UI chrome: height meter, ghost counter, solidify interface, stats screen, and title use styled themed widgets — not raw unstyled HTML 引擎 defaults. Score 0 if primary UI elements are obviously unstyled.

Animation and feedback: ghosts have a translucent shimmer or trail, solidification has a crystallize effect, reaching new heights triggers a celebration, and falling has a dramatic camera or particle effect. Score 0 if all state changes snap silently.
